messages.author: 42e5316f884713d9
messages.subject: Announcement: Ride v 1.2.4 released
parts:
Hi,

I am pleased to let you know that I just released version 1.2.4 of Ride (an IDE for analysis and package development etc. for Renjin).

Highlights include
- Improved SVG handling
- Support for javascript code
- Enhanced interactive options through the rideutils package
- Enhancements to code completion
- Improvements to console output for things like str() which looked ugly before

Ride can be downloaded and installed from here:
https://github.com/perNyfelt/ride/releases/tag/v1.2.4-GA

Best regards,
Per

messages.author: 42e5316f884713d9
messages.subject: Re: Announcement: Ride v 1.2.4 released
parts:
I just double checked on my windows machine. ride.sh runs fine from git bash and ride.cmd runs fine from cmd prompt.
on centos 7 i did:
1. mkdir ride && cd ride
2. wget https://github.com/perNyfelt/ride/releases/download/v1.2.4-GA/ride-1.2.4-GA-dist.zip
3. unzip ride-1.2.4-GA-dist.zip
4. ./ride.sh

No problems there either.

The ride-1.2.4.jar should be in your installation dir next to where the ride.sh is. If it is not there then maybe something went wrong with the unzip? Note that the zip does not contain an initial dir so if you unzipped and then moved the files maybe you missed it?

Best regards,
Per
